title: Samsung SEVT - TTC Duc Hue 2 grid-connected DPPA (Vietnam's first)

parties.buyer_location: Yen Binh Industrial Park, Thai Nguyen province (north)
parties.generator: TTC Duc Hue 2 (developer: TTC Duc Hue-Long An Power JSC)

strike_basis.regulatory_cap_note: Decree 57 caps the grid-DPPA forward price at the RE-type ceiling generation tariff (Southern ground-mount no-storage ~1,012 VND/kWh). Sweep points above the ceiling are sensitivity-only.

quality.caveat: All commercial terms (strike, tenor, KPP/grid fee) are undisclosed and triangulated; headline numbers ride on the assumed strike and a proxy CFMP series. Treat as directional, not bankable.
